candidate.title: Add-guests flow persists new guest attendees with empty name (blank greetings/ICS CN)
reports: addguests.handler.ts:~70 persists guest attendees with empty name, causing blank names in organizer email and ics attendees
new attendees are created with name: "", so the email they receive is addressed with an empty name, greets "hi ,", and the ics attendee carries cn="".
addguests.handler.ts:83-90 — guests are created with name: '' — blank names flow into the attendee list ui and email headers (to: ' <email>', 'hello ,') for every downstream email.

new-guest attendees are created with empty name and organizer's timezone/locale as guesses (addguests.handler.ts:80-88), producing broken email subjects like '...with at ...' and leaking empty names into ics attendee lists

new guests are persisted with name: "" in addguests.handler.ts:83-90, so emails are addressed as " <email>", attendee records/ics carry empty cn values, and the organizer subject line (this.calevent.attendees[0].name) can render a blank name since attendee ordering is unspecified

[advisory] guests are persisted with name:"" and the organizer's timezone and locale, so the attendee record asserts values the guest never provided. every downstream email addresses the guest as ' <email>' with a blank display name and blank greeting, and ics rendering uses the organizer's timezone for the guest.
